My first run with an Asylum Skip.

The Pools loops I do is close to being the best of the worst loops to do (still can't do the best). I was messing around with inputs and here's what I do:

Dash + Up x5
Dash + Up & Left x3
Dash + Down & Left x3
Dash + Down x5
Dash + Left x1
Dash + Down x1
Hold Down

This puts you close to the ledge where you dash jump to Death below. In the run I am quite far away, but have looped to the ledge itself before.
